essence: Placing the śakti-mantra first obstructs the attainment of accomplishment.
In that context, kula-worship is the principal form of worship.
Worshipping Durgā on a kula lunar day makes her grant boons.
Tuesday and Friday are kula, while Wednesday is kula-akula.
Uneven lunar days are akula, and the remaining lunar days are kula.
